query:
UPDATE products SET description = 'The original. The first tee off the line with the script that put Fake on the map. Classic fit, clean print, no explanation needed.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
200 GSM midweight jersey
Classic regular fit
Ribbed crew neck
Reinforced shoulder seams

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
Screen print — built to last' WHERE id = 30001;
UPDATE products SET description = 'The follow-up that hit harder than the original. Same quality, different energy. Worn by people who finish what they start.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
200 GSM midweight jersey
Classic regular fit
Ribbed crew neck
Reinforced shoulder seams

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
Screen print — built to last' WHERE id = 30002;
UPDATE products SET description = 'Confidence isn''t something you find. It''s something you fake until it sticks. Heavyweight build with a graphic that does the talking for you.

MATERIALS:
100% premium combed cotton
220 GSM heavyweight jersey
Relaxed fit
Ribbed crew neck
Double-stitched hems

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on reverse side if needed
DTG print — won''t crack, peel, or fade' WHERE id = 30003;
UPDATE products SET description = 'The hoodie you throw on when you don''t want to try but still want to look like you did. Brushed fleece interior, embroidered logo, kangaroo pocket. Heavy enough to mean business.

MATERIALS:
80% cotton, 20% polyester
380 GSM brushed fleece
Relaxed fit
Ribbed cuffs and hem
Metal-tipped drawcords
Kangaroo pocket

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Do not iron on embroidery' WHERE id = 30004;
UPDATE products SET description = 'Tapered without being tight. Cotton terry with enough stretch to move but enough structure to not look like pajamas. Elastic waistband, zippered pockets, ribbed ankles.

MATERIALS:
80% cotton, 20% polyester
320 GSM french terry
Tapered fit
Elastic waistband with drawcord
Zippered side pockets
Ribbed ankle cuffs

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Do not iron directly on print' WHERE id = 30005;
UPDATE products SET description = 'The polo that doesn''t try too hard. Pique cotton, three-button placket, embroidered logo on the chest. Works at a barbecue or a board meeting — depends on who''s asking.

MATERIALS:
100% pique cotton
220 GSM
Classic fit
Three-button placket
Ribbed collar and sleeve bands
Side vents

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat' WHERE id = 30006;
